source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Touch the bottle tip to the cornea so the medication is delivered directly to the ocular surface and cannot miss the intended site.","B":"Place the medication on the closed eyelid and wait for it to enter the conjunctival space when the eye is opened.","C":"Pull the lower eyelid down to create a pocket, instill the prescribed drops into that pocket, and keep the bottle tip from touching the eye or eyelid.","D":"Rub the closed eye vigorously after each drop because friction improves ocular absorption and decreases contamination of the bottle tip."}}
source_row.rationale: NEI instructs patients to pull the lower lid down to create a pocket, instill the prescribed drops into that pocket, and avoid contact between the bottle tip and the eye or eyelid.
